prompt:
Read the user message as the text of one supplier invoice. Return only one JSON object, with exactly these keys and no others: vendor, invoice_number, issue_date, due_date, currency, net, vat, total. Each value must be a string or null. No Markdown or prose.

Extract the full legal name of the issuer (seller, supplier, payee) as written, including its suffix, never the customer or bill-to party. Copy the invoice's own identifier exactly, without its label; exclude order, PO and customer identifiers. Use the invoice issue date, not an order or delivery date, and the explicitly stated payment due date. Normalize dates to YYYY-MM-DD: preserve ISO year-month-day order, read other numeric dates day-first, and expand two-digit years to 20YY. Recognize written month names, including English, Swedish and German, and ordinal day suffixes.

Use the billing currency of the invoice totals: EUR, SEK, USD, GBP, CHF, NOK or DKK. Map € to EUR, £ to GBP, $ to USD and kr to SEK. Ignore informational currency conversions. Extract net as the stated taxable amount excluding VAT after discounts, not a pre-discount subtotal or an unlabeled line-item amount. Extract vat as the stated tax amount, not its rate, and total as the stated gross payable amount including tax. For each amount, the final comma or dot followed by two digits is the decimal separator. Remove grouping separators and currency notation and output a decimal string with a dot and exactly two decimals.

Use null for any unstated field. Do not guess or calculate: no due date from terms, no net by subtraction, and no tax from a rate. Recognize English, Swedish and German labels, including Fakturanummer, Fakturadatum, Förfallodatum, Moms, Att betala, Rechnungsnummer, Rechnungsdatum, Fällig am, Zahlbar bis, Nettobetrag, MwSt. and Gesamtbetrag. Read through broken lines and OCR typos in labels or prose; values themselves are intact.

Worked example input:
Tavrelin Quillhandel GmbH
Rechnungsempfänger: Norvess Pike GmbH
Rechnungsnummer: TQH-7V-98361
Rechnungsdatum: 08/11/29
Währung: CHF
Zwischensumme: 8.761,40
Nachlass: 361,40
Nettobetrag: 8.400,00
MwSt.: 680,40
Gesamtbetrag: 9.080,40

Worked example output:
{"vendor":"Tavrelin Quillhandel GmbH","invoice_number":"TQH-7V-98361","issue_date":"2029-11-08","due_date":null,"currency":"CHF","net":"8400.00","vat":"680.40","total":"9080.40"}
